common_mistakes.mistake: Pac releases POWER before Gem reaches bubble range or tries to ride Gem instead of the ferry; Isp then lacks the intended bubble route to the upper latch.
common_mistakes.consequence: The ferry requires power, so leaving POWER stops its motion; treating Gem as the carrier does not power that ferry or open Pac's lower door. This stalls the route on the safe floor rather than causing physical harm.
common_mistakes.recovery: Pac returns to POWER and holds it until Gem enters bubble range. Isp catches a later bubble, latches OPEN PAC'S DOOR, and Pac resumes the lower route. This recovery is inferred from authored mechanics, not observed in current44.
